name: harmonized-v1
description: Harmonized configuration for cross-code comparison (cr-propagation r3 5.5), in the transport format of r3 5.4. A code that cannot express an item records the difference and its substitute; it never falls back to a default silently. D1 adds harmonized-v1-<item>.json per item it turns on. sources.injection spectrum_variable (K3, escalation 12): the source spectrum R^-gamma is a density per unit kinetic energy per nucleon, dQ/dE_k/n = q R^-2.3 (eta 0; USINE POWERLAW as run by B1); a code injecting per rigidity or momentum (DRAGON2) differs by a factor beta (up to 3% on B/C at 2-3 GV, VALIDATION CRPROP-D3). sources.abundances: the propagated parent ratios of the theory:cr-secondary-ratio parent list (O/C 0.9; the USINE translator normalises them at E_k/n = 10 GeV/n). DRAGON2 can express neither item: its translator (dragon2_translate.py) refuses both unless DRAGON2's own choices are stated.

sources.spatial: not fixed by harmonized-v1; each code records its choice
sources.abundances: fixed by the parent list of theory:cr-secondary-ratio

cross_sections.ghost_threshold: off: ghost nuclei and tertiary chains off on both sides
